notes: ConditionalsToken (Conditionals, COND) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 COND (1e27 base units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no owner, no external mint or burn, no transfer tax and no post-deployment configuration, so every launch flow moves exactly what it says. No application contracts are deployed. Project site: conditionals-bay.vercel.app.
